prompt:
Use case: scientific-educational. Create one exact 3 by 3 contact sheet containing NINE SQUARE equally sized panels, row-major one progressive outward half repetition, first starting pose through ninth endpoint. No gridlines, gutters, margins between cells, labels, text, numbers, arrows, brands or watermarks. Every panel uses the exact same locked orthographic camera, scale, floor shadows and warm white background. Full athlete and machine fit with modest margin. Athlete style: the muscular adult man from Image2, naturally tan skin with consistent texture, dark short hair, black shorts, black trainers with white soles, high-quality realistic coloured instructional render. NOT a polygon or game character. Image1 is an authoritative kinematic guide: BLUE human joints are fixed-length bone segments; GREY fixed machine parts stay at identical coordinates; ORANGE moving levers rotate without stretching. Translate guide into realistic anatomy and plausible machine, DO NOT render guide lines or dots. Use the positions of every one of the nine cells, not just first and last. No slow camera turn or framing drift.
EXERCISE: seated abdominal crunch in a physically coherent selectorized machine. Follow guide1: a single compact CONNECTED floor chassis supports low seat, short vertical FIXED lumbar/back pad, a fixed side pivot beside the waist, and enclosed weight tower connected via base. Side view facing RIGHT, tiny5degree frontal reveal only for both hands. The machine is a REALISTIC FRONT-PAD ABDOMINAL CRUNCH: a sturdy rigid side lever rotates around a FIXED hinge next to waist/lower ribs, carrying a padded chest/upper-abdomen roller with two handles. The lever rotates forward and DOWN with controlled abdominal flexion, handgrips remain attached. NOT a strange shoulder-pivot chest press, not a rowing machine. Seat and vertical short lumbar pad remain completely FIXED to chassis; do not attach the whole chair/backrest to the moving torso. Athlete is seated, hips/pelvis anchored, feet firmly on fixed supports and knees constant. Start torso upright. Nine progressive poses curl the upper spine FORWARD/DOWN to bring ribs toward pelvis, slight spinal rounding concentrated in upper/lumbar trunk while pelvis stays stationary. The lower back stays against the fixed short lumbar support; upper back gently rolls away. Do NOT depict the whole straight torso merely hinging at hips. Head stays neutral with trunk, not a separate neck nod. Hands hold the two handles and travel with the chest pad; no arm-only pulling. Slight arm elbow adjustment is natural but arm bones never stretch. Chest pad maintains gentle actual front contact throughout. The fixed side hinge, black seat, lumbar pad, feet supports, enclosed tower and floorbase are identical in every cell. Opaque housing hides internal weight stack; no invented multiplying plates. Constant leg/arm proportions, stable skin texture. Use the nine poses of guide, no camera shake.
